title: Tailored Web Applications
desc: Built around how your team actually works - client portals, booking systems, approval steps, or anything specific to your industry. The goal is simple: your team works faster, not around the software.

title: Custom CMS & Admin Dashboards
desc: A simple admin area where you're in full control - update content, manage users, and see your data without fighting a clunky system built for someone else's business. Set up properly from day one, with room to add more later.
alt: Custom CMS and admin dashboard example

title: Secure Logins & Smooth Connections
desc: Different access levels for different staff, secure logins for everyone, and clean connections to the tools you already use - like payment systems, email, or other software you rely on - so nothing needs to be done twice.

title: Built Around ASQA's Requirements
desc: RTO code, scope of registration, fees and charges, refund policy, complaints and appeals, USI information and student rights each get a clear, easy-to-find place on your site from day one, planned around ASQA's requirements instead of added later as an afterthought.
alt: RTO website structure with registration details, fees and student policies

title: Course Pages & Enrolment Paths
desc: An individual page for each qualification, with clear entry requirements, outcomes, fees and an easy enrolment form or enquiry path. Structured so students and Google both understand exactly what you offer.
alt: RTO course page and enrolment form example

title: SEO Foundations for RTOs
desc: On-page SEO built around how students actually search, like “Certificate III in Individual Support” plus their city, or business courses in their state. Clear page titles, headings and course details so the right people find you and get in touch.
alt: SEO foundations for an RTO website
